title: Workflow
key_points: ComfyUI provides a modular and customizable design system for developing web applications.
The workflow in ComfyUI is designed to be simple, efficient, and consistent across different components.
ComfyUI offers a set of guidelines and best practices to ensure a smooth development process.
limitations: The documentation may not cover all specific use cases or edge cases in developing web applications using ComfyUI.
The quality and accuracy of the information provided depend on the completeness and correctness of the documentation.
The scope of the workflow guidelines is limited to the design system and may not encompass the entire development process.
asserts: ComfyUI's workflow emphasizes simplicity, efficiency, and consistency in developing web applications using a modular and customizable design system.
scope: The scope of this document covers the workflow provided by ComfyUI for developing web applications using its design system.
